title: Validate the executable route
when: Before activation, assignment or changing a release policy
need: Read the serving validation result, capabilities, registered targets and deployed-identity proof. Current source supports ordered execution and scoped QA; a stored definition is not evidence the serving build can execute it.
surface: Onboard validate gate; flow schema and identity admission.
gap: JOURNEYS needs a short validation/recovery pointer at the moment a flow is adopted. Used definitions are versioned and retained, not overwritten.
